(shrī)༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur mgon sprin zhabs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa nye brgyud thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅

tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur mgon sprin zhabs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa nye brgyud thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo bīr+ya bha drā ya/ rnam 'dren rgyal ba thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa gcig bsdus nas// grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba yi// thang stong rgyal pos byin gyis rlobs// gang gi zhal gzigs bka' bsgos pas// brgyud 'dzin slob ma'i tshogs bcas pa'i// bka' srung gur gyi mgon po yi// thun mong min pa'i rjes gnang bri// de la 'dir dpal grub pa'i dbang phyug gi nye brgyud las byung zhing*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' srung dam par gyur pa/ gur gyi mgon po sprin zhabs mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa sgrub par byed pa la/ sbyor ba'i rim pa ni/ slob dpon dang zhal sprod du yong bar bla ma yi dam chos skyong 'di nyid kyi bris sku sogs legs par bshams pa'i mdun du stegs bu ji ltar 'tshams par bzang po'i khebs dang ldan pa'i khar 'bru nag gi tshom bu bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la gtor ma gru gsum che ba dmar nag byugs shing*/ rgyan gyi mdzes par byas pa la dar nag gi rgyal mtshan lha tsaka dang bcas pa btsugs pa bzhag de'i g.yas su yi dam gyi gtor ma/ g.yon du mchod gtor gru gsum mtheb kyus bskor ba dang bcas pa bshams pa'i mdun nyer spyod lnga/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril sogs yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya/ dngos gzhi slob dpon dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni yi dam gang dang 'brel ba'i thog mar/ gnas mchod byin rlabs byas/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te dpal kye rdo rje'am/ ma grub na phyag rdor 'byung 'dul lta bu khro bo'i rgyal po gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa grub par byas nas nang mchod byin rlabs byas la gtor ma la bran/

rak+tar dmigs te oṃ ma hā rak+ta āḥhūm̐ gsum dang*/ gtor ma byin rlabs nang mchod ltar bya/ gnyis pa 'di'i mdun bskyed a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ mdun gyi tshom bu dang gtor ma mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su 'jigs byed mun pa tshal gyi dur khrod chen po rol pa'i pho brang 'jigs su rung ba/ sa gzhi thams cad khrag gzhag gis gtams shing*/ ro langs dang keng rus mang po gar byed pa/ hūm̐ phaṭa pheṃ pheṃ gyi sgra sgrog tser ba/ mkha' 'gro dang sha za zhing skyong gi tshogs mang pos gang ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mi ro dmar ser dang bcas pa'i gdan la/ hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gum gyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis char gyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis zhabs dbus man chad sprin rum chen po du ba'i mdog can gyi dbus na nub pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag gi tshogs gshog skor byed pa/ g.yon na khyi nag mang po 'khang zhing zug pa/ rgyab na ce spyang 'bum sde 'bros 'ded byed pa/ mdun na mi nag gtum po 'jigs su rung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrog cing 'o dod 'bod pa/ steng na khyung chen po dpag tu med pa lding zhing 'khor ba/

ye shes kyi me dpung chen po rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i mtha' bka' sdod las byed pho nya sde brgyad dregs pa'i khro tshogs/ dam can rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba zhes gsal btab la/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i thugs ka dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ nā len+d+ra/ dpal ldan sa skya pa/ dpal chen ri bo che'i gnas mchog rnams nas rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po la/ bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥ hūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar// byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru// drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs// mgon po kun gshegs gdan las bzhengs// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥs spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs/ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ zhes gdan 'bul/ phyi mchod ni/ hūm̐/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la// bdag gis mchod pa 'bul ba ni// dmar chen khrag gi ar+ghaṃ dang*// dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog dang*// rus rkang klad pa bsregs pa'i spos// zhu chen gsal ba'i sgron me dang*// rdo rje rang byung dri chab dang*// sha chen rnam lnga'i zhal zas tshogs// rkang gling thod rnga snyan pa'i sgra// dngos 'byor yid sprul mkha' bkang nas// dpal ldan mgon po khyed la 'bul// sku gsung thugs mchog mnyes nas kyang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/

shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ oṃ shrī nas/ wā ra sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rak+ṣam tu nas phyag rgya dang bcas pas dam bzhag dang*/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ slob dpon chen po bram ze mchog sred/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang*/ bdag gi lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i sogs kyi dam bzhag thal brdab dkyus bzhin byas rjes/ mdun bskyed nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyi ljags rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ shrī ma hā nas wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta nas ghṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā lan gsum dang*/ shā sa na gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ shrī nas wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis slar yang phyi mchod dang*/ sngags la oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes nang mchod 'thor/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi zhing mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol zhes phrin bcol bya/ sman raka gtor gsum gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ nag po chen po 'khor bcas la// gzhan yang mchod pa 'bul ba ni// 'bru bcud stong sbyar dza gad dang*// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman// dgra bgegs rnam gnyis bsgral ba yi// don snying sha rus gtor chen bshams// de bzhin tshe 'dzin khrag gi rgyun// ban+dha lcang lo khrag gis bkang*// bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// khyed kyi thugs dam bskangs gyur nas// bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ shrī ma hā nas sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/

ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ zhes 'bul/ gnas dang rgyan gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas 'dir// zhing chen 'phan gdugs bla bre bres// rgyu rlon lda ldi snying phreng 'phyang*// keng rus sna tshogs ri ltar spungs// sha khrag dri gsur rgyun mi chad// sna tshogs rgyan gyi mchod pa 'di// nag po chen po khyed la 'bul// bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs// dgra bgegs rnam gnyis bsgral du gsol// spro na skong ba gzhan yang 'dir bya/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can// sogs nas/ dam tshig can la bdag bstod do// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod pa'o// stob pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la ya/ sogs/ dam nyams yongs kyi gshed ma nag po che// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sogs/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ nag po chen po'i thugs kar hūm̐ dang sngags phreng gsal gdab/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis mgon po'i thugs rgyud bskul ba sogs kyi man ngag gi gnad dang ldan pas/ de wa pi tsu sogs cung zad bzlas pas mgo drangs te/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yi ge bdun pa ci nus bzla/ dngos gzhi slob ma la rjes gnang bya ba'i rim pa la khrus dang me tog bkye bsdu bya/ chos bshad ci rigs pa'i rjes su/ 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che yun du gnas pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir srung ma re bsten dgos la/ de la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis/ dang po ni bsten kyang don chung la nyes pa che ba yin te/ rang yang 'khor ba'i btson rar bcings pa yi// 'jig rten lha yis su zhig skyob par nus// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas bstan srung chen po mang du gsungs pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje nag po chen po/

rgyud las mtshan du thogs pa gur gyi mgon po 'di nyid ni dpal chen po he ru ka'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med pa ste/ rdo rje gur le'u bco lnga pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs las nag po chen po 'di nyid phyung ngo*// hūm̐ gi yi ge las skyes pa// zhes sogs kyis gsal bar bstan cing*/ mgon po mngon par 'byung ba dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud rgyas pa las kyang gsungs shing*/ 'di la sgrub skor gyi rim pa mang bar bzhugs pa thams cad rje btsun sa skya pa'i phyag tu bka' babs pa yin kyang*/ da lam 'dir ni rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las pa chen po grub chen thang stong rgyal po de nyid mon yul sa dang chu dang rdo las me 'bar ba rnams nas brgyud de 'jigs byed mun pa tshal gyi dur khrod chen por phebs pa na/ ro langs bshugs skad sgrogs shing ce spyang gar byed pa sogs 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas der dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus na/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i bla ma bram ze mchog sred dang mjal/ dpal gur gyi mgon po'i gdams pa dang rjes su gnang ba thams cad gnang ste/ nam srod kyi char tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i dus na nam mkha'i klong du sprin phung du ba'i mdog can me 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus su dpal gur gyi mgon po snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyis bskor ba gzigs/ de'i tshe grub pa'i dbang phyug bram ze chen pos mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ khyed kyis rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i phrin las sgrubs shig ces bka' bsgo mdzad de chos skyong du gnang ba nas bzung*/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las byon pa'i grub thob chen po'i nye brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i ye shes mgon po bdun

gur/ phyag bzhi drug bing*/ zhal/ tshogs bdag dkar po/ rnam sras ser chen/ gyi nang nas gtso bor mdzad pa'i gur gyi mgon po de la sprin zhags mar grags pa'i rjes gnang sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bgyi 'os rnams sngon du legs par grub/ khyed rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa la'ang gsum las/ dang po maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas/ nas/ rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ gsum/ rgyun bshags kyi slad du bla ma mdun bskyed gur mgon du gsal ba'i steng du bla ma brgyud pa/ mtha' skor du sangs rgyas byang sems gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa mdzod byas la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs gsum/ rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi sdom pa rnams kyang gzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// sogs gsum/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag la rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i rjes su gnang ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ gsum brjod/ dngos gzhi la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba/ yon tan bzlas pa'i lung*/ phrin las gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba dang lnga las/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang la gzhi bca' ba dang*/ dngos gnyis las/ thog mar dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyis oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsogs brjod pas snang grags kyi chos thams cad stong par sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang de las rang re rnams gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid 'jigs byed mun pa tshal gyi dur khrod ces pa nas/ bcas pa'i gdan la rang rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag sogs nas yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams dpal rdo rje nag po chen po sogs nas/

thugs kar hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs ltar gsal 'debs su bcug de nas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas 'og min rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i thugs ka sogs nas dpal chen ri bo che'i gnas mchog rnams dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi nag po chen po'i thugs ka rnams nas nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sku che chung tshad med grangs med pa rngams brjid dang drag shul dang ldan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khyon thams cad gang ba tsam du byon nas/ spyi bo la sogs pa lus kyi cha shas thams cad du sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la ḍa dril dang spro na rol mo drag po bya zhing*/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug pa dang bcas/ yi ge bdun pa dang shā sa na mang du brjod pa'i mthar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya ā āḥ zhes brjod pas byin rlabs dbab bo// de ltar byin rlabs kyi gzhi bca' ba grub nas rjes gnang dngos la sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon por gsal ba'i dpral ba'i dbyings nas nag po chen po'i sku'i ngo bo oṃ yig dkar po re rgyangs te chad/ khyed rang rnams mgon por gsal ba'i dpral bar thim pas lus kyi bar chad thams cad zhi nas/ nag po chen po'i sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces rol mo sngags dang bcas pa gong bzhin bya/ de bzhin tu mgrin pa'i dbus nas nag po chen po'i gsung gi ngo bo āḥyig dmar po re rgyangs te chad/ khyed rang sogs nas mgrin par sogs/ gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa thob byung snyam pa'i sogs gong bzhin bya/ yang thugs ka'i dbus na nag po chen po thugs ka'i ngo bo hūm̐ yig mthing nag re rgyangs te chad/

khyed rang mgon por sogs nas snying gar sogs dang*/ thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa thob byung sogs rigs 'gre/ yon tan bzlas pa'i lung gi don du bla ma mgon por gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig mthing nag sngags kyis bskor ba dang*/ khyed rang gi snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig gsal btab nas/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng chad pa zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi kha nas zhugs/ snying gar hūm̐ gi mthar dang po 'khod/ phyi ma rnams de la thim pas gsal zhing brtan par byas pa'i mos pa byas nas 'di'i rjes zlos spro na brgya rtsa/ ma grub na lan nyer gcig gi bar du mdzod byas la yi ge bdun pa bzla/ drin lan du me tog bla ma la 'thor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// gsum/ me tog sngags su byin gyis brlabs nas spyi bor bzhag pa'am gtor bas sngags phreng byang chub bar du brtan par byas par mos pa mdzod byas la/ bcom ldan 'di la nas 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ gsum dang*/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la dpal nag po chen po'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod de yon tan bzlas lung ngo*// phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba'i slad du gtor ma nag po chen po mngon rtogs ltar gsal 'debs pa'am/ dam can rgya mtshos bskor ba/ spyi bor byon pa'i steng du rtsa brgyud bla ma/ mtha' skor du yi dam byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs par mos/ rtsa ba'i bla mas bka' bsgos pa bzhin du phrin las thams cad sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la gtor ma mgo bor bzhag cing*/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/

rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ rje btsun kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ 'jam mgon kun dga' grol mchog ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ grub mchog ngag dbang nyi ma/ 'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa rnams skyong ba dang*/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen bsam don chos dang mthun par yid bzhin du 'grub cing*/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob pa sogs gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi phrin las thams cad 'bad med du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad nag po chen po la thim/ slob ma dkyus la/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nag po chen po'i byin rlabs zhugs par mos zhes pas chog bstim par mi byed/ de nyid 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par gyur nas spyi bo nas thim pas khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la byin rlabs thams cad zhugs nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sogs rgyas bsdus gang 'os bya/ ces brjod/ rjes gnang thob nas/ dam tshig rdo rje theg pa spyi dang*/ 'di ga'i bye brag mtha' dag bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sogs rjes kyi chos gsum 'dra/ rjes la mchod pa bran/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa byas/ 'dod don gsol/ 'bul gtor phul/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol/ bsngo smon dang bkra shis bya'o// gur mgon sgrub thabs rjes gnang 'di// ngagaṃ dbaṃng bdag gi 'bad pa yis// bstanaṃ 'dziṃn rnams la bsams nas bkod// 'bras bu phunaṃ sum tshoṃgs gyur cig /gur mgon nye brgyud sprin zhabs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi le'u tshan no// sarba dā maṅgalaṃ//

// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
